About the job

At Saxo, we believe access to global capital markets should be simple and accessible. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting Saxo's continued growth, innovation and strategic ambitions.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will provide trusted legal advice across a broad range of business initiatives, regulatory developments, corporate matters, commercial activities, governance matters and strategic projects. Working closely with stakeholders across our offices in both Denmark and abroad, you will help ensure that legal considerations enable business success while maintaining the highest standards of governance, integrity and regulatory compliance.

This role combines strong legal expertise with stakeholder management and business partnership. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will act as a trusted advisor across Saxo, providing pragmatic legal guidance and partnering with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation to navigate legal complexity and support informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will:

• Provide strategic legal advice to key stakeholders across Saxo.

• Support commercial, corporate, governance and regulatory matters affecting the business.

• Advise on marketing activities, customer communications, commercial partnerships and strategic business initiatives.

• Partner with business stakeholders to ensure legal risks are appropriately identified and managed.

• Support product development, business expansion initiatives and corporate projects.

• Contribute to effective legal governance frameworks and decision-making processes.

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit and other control functions.

• Manage relationships with external counsel and legal service providers.

• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to the continuous development of the Legal function and strengthen its role as a proactive business partner.

Your profile

You are an experienced legal professional with a strong legal foundation and a proven ability to navigate complex business challenges in a highly regulated environment.

You bring solid legal expertise, sound commercial judgement and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the organisation. You are comfortable balancing legal risk with business priorities and have a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to legal advisory.

To succeed in this role, you will preferably have:

• A master's degree in law or an equivalent legal qualification.

• Solidlegal experience preferably gained either within the financial services industry or at a leading law firm advising clients in regulated sectors.

• Understanding of the legal and regulatory framework governing financial institutions and financial markets.

• Experience advising business stakeholders on legal matters in relation to strategic initiatives and commercial matters.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal matters into practical business advice.

• A proactive, commercially minded and collaborative approach.

Beyond your technical legal capabilities, you are a trusted business partner who builds strong relationships across the organisation and enables informed decision-making while maintaining a high standard of legal governance and integrity.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

Für das Hotel Hesselet wird ein Kellner gesucht.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, ein neues Restauranterlebnis im Hotel Hesselet zu eröffnen? Am 1. März 2027 eröffnen wir das Restaurant Hi – ein neu erbautes Pavillonrestaurant im Hotel Hesselet, das als exklusives kulinarisches Universum mit offener Küche, einladendem Ambiente und einem starken Fokus auf Gastfreundschaft, Kultur und ganzheitliche Erlebnisse geschaffen wurde.

Das Hotel Hesselet liegt an einem der schönsten Orte Fünens. Direkt dort, wo der Wald auf das Meer trifft und man die Brücke zwischen Seeland und Fünen sehen kann. Das Hotel befindet sich in Nyborg, das im Mittelalter der Treffpunkt des Königs mit den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten des Reiches war. Heute ist das Hotel ein Ort der Begegnung, an dem Gastfreundschaft zur Geborgenheit wird.

Das Hotel ist nach dem Wald benannt, in dem es liegt. Hesselet bedeutet „Ort, wo die kleinen Haselnusssträucher wachsen“. Wir sind stolz darauf, zu Dänemarks beliebtesten Strandhotels zu gehören und bemühen uns, all unseren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten – egal ob sie bei uns übernachten, speisen oder an einer Konferenz teilnehmen.

Das Hotel Hesselet verändert sich – und ist in guten Händen

Im Jahr 2024 wurde das Hotel Hesselet vom Carama Family Office übernommen, das eine klare Vision verfolgt: die Seele von Hesselet zu bewahren und gleichzeitig das Hotel für zukünftige Gästeerlebnisse weiterzuentwickeln – ohne dabei die Geschichte und die Wärme des Ortes zu beeinträchtigen.

Die neuen Eigentümer haben mit einer behutsamen Renovierung der Hoteleinrichtungen, des Restaurants und der Außenanlagen begonnen. Es wird sowohl in das Ambiente als auch in die Mitarbeiter investiert – mit einem starken Fokus auf Professionalität, Wohlbefinden und erstklassigen Service.

Das Ziel ist ambitioniert, aber klar: Das Hotel Hesselet soll zu den attraktivsten Hotels Dänemarks zählen – sowohl für Gäste als auch für Mitarbeiter. Hier soll man die besondere Ruhe, Qualität und Atmosphäre spüren können, für die Hesselet seit 1967 bekannt ist – in einer zeitgemäßen und modernen Interpretation.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und großartige Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten?

Wir suchen einen Kellner, der Teil eines kompetenten Teams werden möchte, in dem stolze Traditionen, hohe Qualität und eine gute Atmosphäre Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Teil unseres Servicepersonals arbeiten Sie in unserem Restaurant, in Veranstaltungsräumen und bei Konferenzen.

Sie werden ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Gästeerlebnisses sein – vom Frühstück und Mittagessen bis zum Abendservice und besonderen Veranstaltungen.

Wir bieten:

• Ein starkes, engagiertes Team mit tollen Kollegen und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit

• Ein Arbeitsplatz mit hohem Serviceniveau und vielen Stammkunden

• Möglichkeit zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Alltag mit alltäglichen Gästen, Partys und Treffen

• Eine fantastische Lage und ein Haus mit Seele und Geschichte

Wir erwarten von Ihnen Folgendes:

• Er ist ein Kellner und legt großen Wert auf guten Service und Gastfreundschaft.

• Behalten Sie den Überblick, bleiben Sie ruhig und lächeln Sie – auch wenn es mal hektisch zugeht.

• Ist flexibel und kann Termine einhalten

• Blüht in Teamarbeit auf, kann aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung übernehmen.

• Ich interessiere mich für Wein, Essen und Gästeerlebnisse.

Arbeitsumfeld

Im Hotel Hesselet pflegen wir eine herzliche, familiäre und freundschaftliche Atmosphäre – sowohl unter Kollegen als auch gegenüber unseren Gästen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ergebnisse durch echte Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Präsenz und Interesse entstehen.

Wir erwarten von Ihnen, dass Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Energie und Ihr Engagement einbringen – sowohl in Ihrer Arbeit als auch im Umgang mit Kollegen und Gästen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen und als Team zusammenarbeiten, wobei Wohlbefinden und Erfolg gleichermaßen im Fokus stehen.

Wir arbeiten intensiv daran, einen der besten Arbeitsplätze der Branche in Dänemark zu schaffen – und als Teil unseres Serviceteams werden Sie Teil eines engagierten und dynamischen Unternehmens mit ambitionierten Zielen und hoher Professionalität. Wir bieten gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein gesundes Arbeitsumfeld und viel Raum, um mit den Aufgaben zu wachsen.

Gehalt und Konditionen

Gehalt nach Qualifikation. Zusätzlich bieten wir Altersvorsorge, Krankenversicherung und weitere Beschäftigungsbedingungen gemäß Tarifvertrag und gegebenenfalls weiterer Vereinbarung. Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin oder nach Vereinbarung.

Senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung und Ihren Lebenslauf an unseren Restaurantleiter Rasmus Weimar unter rasmus@hesselet.dk – am besten so bald wie möglich, da wir laufend Vorstellungsgespräche führen.

Sollten Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie ihn gerne direkt unter der Telefonnummer (45) 65 31 30 29 kontaktieren.

Klingt das nach etwas, von dem Sie gerne hören würden? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.

Job description

Do you want to build intelligent software that powers the future of sports coaching? Are you passionate about transforming raw data and AI model predictions into meaningful, real-world metrics for professional American football players? Then come and join our ambitious and collaborative product team!

Data is revolutionizing sports. Join our team to play.

This is a great opportunity to join our growing New Sports team within our Tracking Department. Our team is responsible for the development of the firmware for our American football products. We are developing cutting-edge solutions that leverage deep learning, classic computer vision, machine learning, and signal processing algorithms to deliver product features. Through our market leading radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by some of the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• 
Detecting and tracking objects, such as balls, players, and clubs, across several different sports

• 
Optical flow for determining ball flight characteristics

• 
Calibration between radar and camera data for drawing tracks in broadcast television

• 
Human pose tracking for analyzing athlete performance

Are you our new colleague?

Our ideal candidate is specialized the area of computer vision and machine learning. You will be joining a team of specialists within these fields and together we strive to remain the best in the world at what we do. Your responsibilities will include development of new and existing products and core processes based on your experience and skills.

In the new sports team we value teamwork and openness. Therefore, we expect you to enjoy working with other highly motivated colleagues and help provide a good working environment. We do not expect that you can be an expert on every aspect of being a developer, but rather strive to improve and learn together with the team.

Responsibilities:

• 
Develop advanced DL, ML, classic computer vision, algorithms.

• 
Write production ready code, with emphasis on deployment, monitoring and supportability

• 
Design and execute experiments to acquire and prepare datasets for algorithm development

• 
Develop and extend tooling for computer vision development. This can include data visualization, annotation and debugging

• 
Develop appropriate system architecture for edge-based and server solutions

• 
Collaborate with engineers within Vision & AI and the tracking department to produce high quality cutting edge systems

Job requirements

• 
Master’s Degree or Ph.D. in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, mathematical modelling, or equivalent

• 
3+ years of practical experience in implementing and deploying computer vision systems, with a proven track record of successful project execution and system optimization

• 
Strong software development and programming skills within Python and C++

• 
Experienced in computer vision techniques, including object detection, video tracking, and image analysis, as well as deep learning and convolutional neural networks in machine learning

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive on taking an idea from concept to a polished implementation.

Nice to haves:

• 
Experience with or knowledge of image acquisition, camera calibration

• 
Preferably experience with or knowledge of video formats and camera hardware, drivers and low-level software

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative and pro-active in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables. We expect you to be of a similar caliber.

We offer:

• 
Highly skilled colleagues

• 
World class office facilities

• 
International environment with more than 35 nationalities in our HQ

• 
Social activities

Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Share our Passion!

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Read the Stibo DX story and about working at Stibo DX.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and tasks

We are looking for a Project Manager to lead service, upgrade, retrofit and modification projects within automation and control systems delivered to energy sector process- or offshore industry. In this role, you will take ownership of your own projects and play a key part in ensuring successful delivery for customers within either the energy sector, process- & production industry or to offshore clients (e.g. power plants, district heating facilities, waste incineration plants).

Working closely with customers, engineering teams and experienced project management colleagues, you will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from planning and coordination to execution and completion. This position offers an excellent opportunity to further develop your project management career while gaining exposure to technically advanced solutions, customer collaboration and commercial project execution in an international organization. If you enjoy taking ownership, building relationships and turning plans into successful project deliveries, this could be the ideal next step in your career.

Your responsibilities will include

• Managing service, retrofit and upgrade projects from tender phase through execution and final delivery.

• Leading project planning, scheduling, resource plans and execution activities.

• Building strong customer relationships and acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.

• Managing commercial risks, project changes, claims and recovery actions.

• Project financials steering, including forecasting, cost control and value optimization.

• Identifying & pursuing aftermarket opportunities for upselling.

• Driving contract management and change management activities.

• Ensuring compliance with ABB quality, cybersecurity and HSE requirements.

Qualifications for the role

• 4–7 years of project management experience within technical, industrial or automation-related environments.

• Proven experience managing project financials, commercial risks and contractual obligations.

• Solid experience leading project teams and driving delivery towards agreed goals and milestones, including experience with remote management.

• Experience working with customers and cross-functional stakeholders in complex project environments.

• Strong understanding of project planning, budgeting and project execution methodologies.

• Experience delivering projects from tender phase through commissioning and handover.

• Knowledge of automation, OT or industrial control systems, preferably within energy, process, power or offshore industries.

• Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English, as well as experience working with tools such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project or similar. PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA or a comparable project management certification is considered an advantage.

More about us

At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at one of our offices in Ballerup, Middelfart or Esbjerg, alongside your closest colleagues. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week. Since you support customers across Denmark, you can expect some time on the road, as well as occasional international travel - primarily to the other Nordic countries.

The position reports to Head of Project Management in Service, Nicolai Heilskov.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Nicolai Heilskov at +45 21 15 34 38.

The application deadline is 08.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Saab Danmark A/S - Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
Saab Danmark is entering an exciting phase of growth and transformation. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer (CPO) who can define direction, drive execution, and lead the evolution of our products, technology, and product organization. You will play a key role in strengthening our product platform, advancing our digital capabilities, and positioning Saab Danmark for sustainable long-term growth.

Reporting to the CEO and serving as a member of the Danish Management Team, you will hold overall responsibility for Saab Danmark's Product Organization, including Product Management and Product Development across Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing.

As CPO, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Saab Danmark's next chapter. While ensuring successful delivery across an active project portfolio, you will lead the transition towards a stronger product-centric approach, where a scalable core platform enables future innovation, customer solutions, and digital services.

This role requires a leader who can combine strategic vision with operational excellence, create followership across the organization, and unite technology, product development, and business priorities into one coherent direction.

Key responsibilities

• 
Define, maintain, and drive the overall product, technology strategy in alignment with Saab’s vision, business objectives, and future market opportunities.

• 
Develop and execute a product roadmap that balances short-term delivery commitments with long-term product and technology investments.

• 
Lead and develop the Product Organization through Product Management, Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing leadership teams.

• 
Strengthen Product Management capabilities and ways of working, ensuring clear ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer value creation across the organization.

• 
Drive the evolution towards a more software-defined, cloud-enabled, and service-oriented product architecture, translating emerging technologies and digital trends into sustainable customer value.

• 
Ensure alignment between customer needs, business priorities, technology development, and product investments.

• 
Establish and strengthen the core product platform, enabling future customer solutions to be delivered through configuration, extension, and scalable reuse rather than repeated customization.

• 
Foster organizational effectiveness, accountability, and execution across the full product lifecycle.

• 
Build an aligned and high-performing leadership team by creating clarity, strengthening leadership capabilities, and fostering commitment to a shared direction across experienced technical leaders and specialist disciplines.

• 
Ensure clear prioritization of resources and development initiatives across competing demands.

• 
Safeguard the long-term direction, architecture, and integrity of Saab Danmark’s product portfolio.

• 
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, learning, and ownership.

• 
Contribute actively to company strategy and decision-making as a member of the company Management Team.

What you bring

You are an experienced product and technology leader with a strong track record from Product Management, Software Engineering, Product Development, or similarly complex technology-driven environments.

You have successfully led organizations through growth, change, and transformation and know how to create results through clear direction, strong leadership, and effective collaboration.

You are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels and have demonstrated the ability to translate ambitious visions into tangible business outcomes.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Experience from software-centric or software-defined product environments where product strategy, engineering excellence, and customer value creation are closely connected.

• 
Strong experience with Product Management, product strategy, roadmap management, and portfolio prioritization.

• 
A solid understanding of modern software development practices, platform thinking, and cloud technologies.

• 
Experience leading product, platform, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives and translating strategic ambitions into measurable organizational and business outcomes.

• 
Experience balancing the demands of ongoing customer deliveries with the long-term development of scalable products, platforms, and capabilities.

• 
The ability to balance operational delivery with long-term capability building.

• 
A strong commercial mindset combined with a deep appreciation for technology and innovation.

• 
The ability to navigate competing priorities and make clear decisions in complex environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment across diverse functions and leadership levels.

• 
Experience building trust, credibility, and followership in organizations with highly experienced technical leaders and specialists.

• 
Curiosity about emerging technologies and their potential impact on products, services, and business models.

In addition, you must be able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required by Danish Defence Intelligence Service for this position. This typically requires candidates to have resided within a NATO or EU member state for the past seven years.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic leader who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline.

You create clarity in complex environments, make priorities visible, and build followership through professional credibility, sound judgement, and consistent leadership. You are comfortable leading experienced managers and specialists and create alignment and commitment around a shared direction.

Why Saab Danmark?

This is an opportunity to play a defining role in shaping the future of Saab Danmark. You will influence the direction of our products, contribute to company strategy, and help position Saab Danmark for its next stage of growth.

If you are motivated by building great products, shaping organizational direction, and creating lasting business impact, this is an opportunity to play a key role in Saab Danmark's continued development and growth.

jobs.occupation: AIV Planner - help turn spacecraft assembly into a scalable production flow
jobs.description:
In our Satellite Assembly, Integration, and Verification Team, you will be at the center of planning how spacecraft are assembled, integrated, tested, and tracked. You will translate complex AIV activities into executable production flows and system structures, while coordinating the interfaces that make the flow work in practice. If you combine strong systems understanding with structure, initiative, and a drive to build better solutions, this is your opportunity to shape how we manufacture satellites.

About the Position as AIV Planner

As AIV Planner, you will own the planning framework supporting spacecraft assembly and verification. You will establish and maintain production flows, routings, and planning data in our ERP system while coordinating activities across AIV, production, project management, and logistics to ensure efficient execution.

You will play a key role in developing scalable planning processes, improving digital ways of working, and connecting future ERP and MES capabilities to the needs of spacecraft production. Your experience and ideas will directly influence a more controlled, digital, and scalable production flow.

Responsibilities include:

You will ensure that spacecraft build plans are translated into controlled and executable work in our operational systems, while aligning the interfaces needed for reliable AIV execution.

Production Planning and System Execution

• Create and maintain AIV routings, production orders, planning parameters, and relevant production master data in the ERP system.

• Translate engineering structures and AIV plans into practical production sequences with clear dependencies, revisions, effectivity, and material requirements.

• Monitor order progress and data quality, resolve planning issues, and help establish the ERP system as the operational source of truth for spacecraft build execution.

Cross-functional Planning and Material Flow

• Coordinate with Electronic Production, Project Management, AIV, engineering, warehouse, and other planners to align readiness, priorities, materials, and handovers.

• Coordinate AIV inventory and material flow, including allocation, kitting, shortages, transfers, returns, and controlled movement of hardware.

Configuration, Change, and Improvement

• Maintain configuration and traceability in the ERP system, including correct parts, revisions, serial numbers, routings, effectivity, material movements, and as-built status.

• Assist the ECR/ECO process by identifying affected routings and production orders, supporting change-impact assessment, and implementing approved changes in the ERP system with the required traceability.

What you bring

At GomSpace, it’s not just your technical skills that matter - your character is also important. We value individuals who bring a positive, proactive attitude and can build trust across cultures. The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking ownership in an environment that is still being built, combining a strong systems understanding with practical knowledge of production flows and the ability to quickly learn new tools and processes.

You likely:

• Have minimum 3 years of experience in production planning, working with ERP, MES, or similar operational systems. Experience with IFS is a strong plus, but not mandatory.

• Practical understanding of production flows, routings, production orders, material availability, sequencing, and master data.

• Ability to understand system relationships and translate engineering and operational inputs into a clear, executable production flow.

• Experience with configuration management, revision control, serial-number traceability, and as-built records.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple interfaces and turn incomplete or changing inputs into a structured plan.

• Strong drive, ownership, and a solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to establish and improve processes rather than only operate existing ones.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in Danish or English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. Apply for the job by following the link below.

If you have any questions with regard to the position do not hesitate to contact: Simon Holt Olsen, Head of AIV, shol@gomspace.com.

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark and it is expected that most of the time is in the offices.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 300 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on www.gomspace.com

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

Application deadline:

As soon as possible

Are you ready to turn strategy into action and create visible impact at the heart of a dynamic production site?

Would you like to join us?

Do you enjoy finding the biggest commercial opportunities, improving customer journeys, and turning data into initiatives that drive measurable growth? Keep reading!

At Limepack, E-commerce is at the heart of how we acquire and convert customers across Europe. As we grow, we see significant potential to improve the customer journey and webshop performance across our markets, while becoming much better at what happens after the first purchase: building stronger relationships, increasing repeat purchases, and growing customer lifetime value.

With our current E-commerce Manager going on maternity leave, this role has a unique starting point. You’ll initially take ownership of E-commerce growth and customer journey optimisation, but this is not simply a 10–12 month maternity cover. The role is designed to evolve with you: over time, your focus will shift towards becoming Limepack’s Loyalty Lead, taking long-term ownership of Post-Purchase, CRM & Lifecycle.

This is a role for someone who combines commercial thinking with strong execution. You’ll use data to identify where the biggest opportunities are, set priorities, and drive initiatives across teams, taking responsibility for turning ideas into measurable results.

📋 Your responsibilities and impact

Your focus will evolve as you grow into the role: starting with E-commerce and gradually taking ownership of Loyalty, CRM, Email and Lifecycle.

• Grow E-commerce performance: Own and improve webshop conversion, customer journeys, AOV and revenue across markets. Identify the biggest opportunities and turn them into scalable improvements.

• Lead and collaborate across our tech setup: For the first 10–12 months, you will lead Alexander, our UX/Frontend Developer, who will report to you, while you report to our CCO. You will also work closely with our two Backend Developers and external partners to bring initiatives from idea to implementation.

• Turn data into priorities: Use customer and commercial data to understand where we should focus, build a clear roadmap, and follow up on the KPIs that matter.

• Drive projects from idea to impact: Lead high-impact initiatives across teams, create clear ownership, and make sure the right people and resources come together to deliver on time.

• Build for scale: Look beyond one-off improvements and create solutions that can work effectively across Limepack’s European markets.

• Build our Loyalty engine: After 10-12 months, own and improve the customer journey beyond the first purchase across Post-Purchase, CRM, Email and Lifecycle. Build stronger customer relationships, increase repeat purchases and grow customer lifetime value.

What success looks like: Within your first 12 months, you’ll aim to increase webshop conversion by 30%, help deliver our 2027 E-commerce revenue target of 40M in new business, and establish clear ownership and priorities for Loyalty. Longer term, you’ll drive improvements in repeat purchase rate, CLV and lifecycle revenue, including increasing first-to-second-purchase retention from 40% to 50%.

👉 Who you are

• You think commercially: You naturally look for the opportunities that will have the biggest impact on revenue and customer value, rather than simply working through a list of tasks.

• You are analytical and curious: You enjoy digging into data, understanding what customers are doing, and using those insights to decide what to improve next.

• You make things happen: You take ownership from opportunity to execution, create structure around projects, and follow through until the result is delivered.

• You are always looking for a better way: You enjoy improving customer journeys, processes and systems and think about how solutions can be scaled rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.

• You are strong across teams: You’re comfortable driving projects through people you don’t directly manage, aligning different stakeholders, and creating clarity around priorities and ownership.

🎓 Your experience

To succeed in this role, you should bring a strong combination of E-commerce experience, commercial thinking, analytical skills and project ownership.

• You have 3–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in E-commerce, digital growth, CRO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, or a similar commercially focused role.

• You have owned E-commerce performance and can point to measurable commercial results you personally helped create.

• You have hands-on experience with CRO and customer journey optimisation and know how to turn insights into improvements.

• You are strong with data, prioritization and project management, and are comfortable coordinating initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Experience with CRM, lifecycle, retention or multi-market E-commerce is a strong advantage.

🚀 Who We Are

Limepack is a profitable Copenhagen-based European scale-up making custom-branded takeaway packaging accessible to businesses of all sizes. Since 2018, we’ve expanded across 14 countries by partnering with European manufacturers to offer faster, more affordable, and more sustainable packaging solutions.

We’re growing fast: we’ve been named a Børsen Gazelle four years in a row for exceptional revenue growth (Limepack.com/growth), and our ambition is to triple revenue over the next three years.

Today, we’re a team of 33 people, including 14 remote colleagues. We put a lot of emphasis on building a great place to work, and we’re proud to be a certified Happy Workplace (Limepack.com/happy). 🚀

💚 We offer:

• A full-time position based in Copenhagen with flexibility to work from home.

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• 6 weeks of paid time off, pay during sick days, and generous paid parental leave.

• The opportunity to take ownership of an important commercial area and grow from E-commerce ownership into leading Limepack’s Loyalty, CRM & Lifecycle agenda.

Software Engineer, Technical Department, Cavendish Hydrogen, Herning

Are you ready to help advance the transition to clean mobility? At Cavendish Hydrogen, we are driven by a clear and vital mission: accelerating the global transition to zero-emission heavy-duty transportation. As a dedicated hydrogen fueling company, we design, deliver, and service cutting-edge hydrogen refueling stations (HRS) for customers across Europe, North America and Asia.

To support our growing international operations, we are looking for a curious, adaptable, and solution-oriented Software Engineer to join our Technical Department within Operations at our headquarters in Lind, Herning. In this role, you will contribute to the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of our hydrogen refueling solutions, helping customers around the world transition to sustainable transportation.

About the job

As our Software Engineer you will connect our global field operations with our in-house software and innovation teams. You will be responsible for ensuring our customers’ hydrogen fueling stations perform safely, reliably, and efficiently across the globe. You will join an agile and collaborative Technical Department comprising of seven skilled colleagues. The team supports service technicians, project managers, and international customers.

Our software architecture is fully developed in-house. You will work closely with Application Engineering and the R&D Software Team to troubleshoot operational issues, implement software adjustments, and optimize live systems.

Key responsibilities and tasks

Operational support & advanced troubleshooting

• Provide software expertise to field service technicians, project teams, and global customers.

• Analyze machine telemetry, logs, and system data to identify operational issues.

• Conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA) of software- and control-related incidents and coordinate corrective actions.

• Prioritize, manage, and escalate complex technical software challenges to relevant engineering teams.

Software adjustments & minor feature improvements

• Define, test, and deploy operational software adjustments, bug fixes, and site-specific parameter configurations.

• Implement urgent software updates while maintaining code integrity and alignment with the R&D Software Team.

• Translate field observations into clear specifications, user stories, and feature requests.

Remote commissioning support & knowledge sharing

• Support remote commissioning, factory testing, and system energization of new stations from our test facilities in Lind.

• Connect the Technical Department with Application Engineering and the R&D Software Team to support effective knowledge sharing and problem-solving.

About you

You may be a recent graduate ready to begin a career in green technology or an experienced engineer seeking meaningful industrial impact. Because our software is developed in-house, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a willingness to learn are more important than experience with specific third-party tools.

Educational Background: You have a degree in Software Engineering, Automation & Control, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Relevant practical experience or an equivalent technical background is also welcome.

Interest in in-house software architecture: You are motivated to understand how software interacts with complex physical equipment including valves, compressors, cooling systems, and high-pressure gas controls.

PLC and automation experience: Experience with PLC programming in Structured Text under IEC 61131-3 is beneficial. Familiarity with Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 is an advantage but not a requirement.

Analytical approach: You are comfortable analyzing data and diagnostic logs and use a structured approach to root-cause investigation.

International flexibility: you can occasionally adjust your working hours to collaborate with colleagues and partners in North American or Asian time zones.

Language and communication: You communicate confidently in written and spoken English, our corporate language.

What we offer

Structured onboarding and mentoring: Experienced software and service engineers who will guide you through our software architecture and station design. Certified Beckhoff TwinCAT training may also be provided where relevant, and you will receive ongoing support from the R&D Software team.

Meaningful impact: Your work will help improve the uptime of commercial hydrogen refueling stations and keep zero-emission fleets operating.

Modern facilities in Lind: You will work in modern facilities with advanced test bays, a high-quality lunch canteen, an active staff association, and health insurance.

Flexibility & work-life balance: Your primary workplace and team will be based in Lind, with flexible working arrangements available.

No regular travel: You will support international remotely, without the need for frequent business travel.

Collaborative culture: You will join an informal and open workplace where questions, knowledge sharing, and autonomy are encouraged.

Apply now

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Curious to learn more?

For technical or role-specific questions, please contact Kim Hehlert, Technical Department Manager at +45 26 31 31 33.

For questions about the recruitment process, please contact Elsebeth Haarup Rasmussen, Head of HR, at +45 22 77 76 13.

Location: Lind, 7400 Herning, Denmark

This role is an exciting opportunity to blend scientific expertise with impactful communication, helping shape innovative healthcare solutions at a globally leading company like Novo Nordisk!

Your new the role

This is a permanent position in Medical Writing. In this role, your main responsibility will be to drive the preparation of complex clinical documents and act as a project manager. More specifically, you are expected to lead tasks such as:

We are globally oriented and you will work in close collaboration with colleagues in cross-functional teams in both Denmark and abroad. The position is office-based in Søborg, Denmark.

Your new department

You will join us in Clinical Reporting, the medical writing function at Novo, currently comprising around 200+ medical writers worldwide. We are part of Novo Development and anchored together with Regulatory and Quality functional areas. Development is responsible for managing clinical drug development and submissions to health authorities worldwide, from the early development phases to market authorisation. Our supportive culture drives business transformation, and we value continuous learning, being bold, and striving for simplicity.

Clinical Reporting covers all clinical drug development projects across therapy areas. Our main focus is to use our scientific expertise to drive clear and impactful communication on the conduct and outcome of clinical trials, and our main task is to communicate clinical data in a clear and concise manner.

Your skills and qualifications

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:

• A high level of expertise in communicating scientific information, with the ability to tailor such information to meet diverse objectives.

• The ability to improve processes and to promote the sharing of better practices.

• A good understanding of clinical development, regulatory processes and requirements, and clinical documents.

• Full proficiency in spoken and written English.

On a personal level, you are a clear communicator who adapts easily to a changing environment with tight deadlines. You are strategic, proactive and have excellent planning and coordination skills with the competency to drive and engage teams. You are a collaborative team player, that effectively manage various stakeholders and can reach consensus. You are detail-oriented and structured, while being pragmatic and not afraid of challenging the status quo. Furthermore, you have a positive can-do attitude and a good sense of humour.

For over 100 years, this unordinary mindset has seen us build a company unlike any other. One where a collective passion for our purpose, mutual respect, and a willingness to go beyond what we know delivers extraordinary results.

What We Offer

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of new business, partners and existing customers in one place. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Has had a budget and hit it, and can explain in detail how

• 
Experience selling outside Denmark, and a feel for what changes when you do

Strong product and technology understanding, and uses AI every day in their own work

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The brain

The agents are the arms. The next layer is a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers: conversations on chat, email, phone and social, on-site behaviour, orders, returns and reviews.

The system identifies the moments where a sale is won or lost and intervenes while the session is still live. It scores answer coverage per product and closes the gaps, quantifies objections and unmet demand, and traces returns back to the expectation that broke.

Learning happens across all webshops, more than six million visits a month, where patterns become visible that no single shop has the traffic to see. Every intervention is measured against a control group. The patterns are shared, the data stays with each shop.

The hard problems are retrieval and evaluation of LLM output at scale, data isolation when patterns are shared across customers, latency in real-time flows, and attribution that holds up under scrutiny.

The stack

Java with Spring Boot, React and MongoDB, with language models and vector search on top. Moving the backend to C# and .NET is under consideration.

The role

Technical ownership of the platform: architecture, code quality, operations, security and prioritisation, combined with hands-on development every day. Standards for review, testing, monitoring and releases, and recruiting the next developers.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished tech organisation with fixed processes. The standards for review, testing, operations and releases, and the developers you hire, become the foundation the platform and the team grow on.
